RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: Cannot responsibly assign a number from these facts.

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence of sex bias. Raise its composition if applicable rules require gender balance or you have additional evidence of unequal treatment—not as an accusation based on members’ sex.

Your qualifications justify asking how candidates were assessed, but the announcement may omit relevant qualifications, and interviews may legitimately affect selection.

Follow up now on your unanswered request. Ask for the selection criteria, their weighting, your assessment, and the reasons for preferring the successful candidate, subject to privacy rules. Keep records and check local complaint deadlines promptly; waiting for an explanation may not pause them. Your jurisdiction matters to both panel-composition rules and response deadlines.
